title: Design System: LCC Lead Engine — Marketing Site

display.purpose: Hero H1 only. One per page.

headline.purpose: Subroute H1 (About, FAQ, Au Pairs, Testimonials).

title.purpose: Home-page section H2 above body content.

body.purpose: Lede under H1 and body inside cards. Default reading size.

label.purpose: Uppercase section anchor above titles. The site's most repeated typographic gesture.

shadows.name: resting-card
shadows.purpose: Whisper-shadow under every white card. Reads as edge softening, not lift.

shadows.name: hover-card
shadows.purpose: Applied on hover, paired with -translate-y-1. Card commits visibly to interaction.

shadows.name: hero-lift
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the hero photo placeholder. Single largest shadow on the site.

shadows.name: sticky-nav
shadows.purpose: Identical to resting-card. Nav floats on a thin shadow plus a 1px border.

motion.name: ease-default
motion.purpose: Tailwind default. Used on all transitions today. Should migrate to ease-out-quart for state transitions per impeccable motion rule.

motion.name: fade-in-duration
motion.purpose: FadeInSection scroll-reveal. Currently does not respect prefers-reduced-motion (must be fixed).

motion.name: accordion-duration
motion.purpose: Radix accordion height transition for FAQ collapses.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Card and button hover lift. -translate-y-1 (4px) on cards, -translate-y-0.5 (2px) on buttons.

components.name: Primary Button (Hero)
components.description: Large pill CTA used on the hero and standalone get-started sections. Hover lifts and shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #C9637A; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; padding: 1rem 2rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #B5566C; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9637A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Button (Compact, Nav)
components.description: Smaller pill CTA used in the sticky nav as the always-visible action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-compact { display: inline-block; background: #C9637A; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary-compact:hover { background: #B5566C; } .ds-btn-primary-compact:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9637A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Default Card
components.description: White card on pink-tinted section background. Soft pink border, whisper shadow, hover lifts.
components.html: As a certified Local Childcare Consultant, I have spent years guiding families through the process of welcoming an au pair into their home.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #F3E6E9; border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-body { color: #6B7280; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Eyebrow + Title Stack
components.description: The site's most-repeated composition. Uppercase eyebrow label in primary, then a large weight-700 title. Anchors every section.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow-stack { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-eyebrow { color: #C9637A; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 0.75rem 0; } .ds-section-title { color: #111827; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0; }

components.name: Inline Link with Arrow
components.description: The system's secondary CTA. In-context link in primary color with a right-arrow glyph. Used as 'Read more →', 'Learn more →', 'See all →'.
components.css: .ds-inline-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; color: #C9637A; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-inline-link:hover { color: #B5566C; } .ds-inline-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9637A; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Sticky Top Nav
components.description: Sticky white nav bar with brand link, route links, and a compact pill CTA. Border-bottom plus whisper shadow.
components.html:
Kim Arvdalen
AboutAu PairsFAQTestimonials
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; background: #FFFFFF; border-bottom: 1px solid #F3E6E9; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); height: 4rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-brand { color: #111827; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-brand:hover { color: #C9637A; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; } .ds-nav-link { color: #6B7280; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #111827; } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #C9637A; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-primary-compact { background: #C9637A; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary-compact:hover { background: #B5566C; }

narrative.overview: This is a baseline capture of the current visual system, not the target. The site greets a tired SoCal parent at 10pm with a familiar warm-consumer signature: dusty rose accents, generous whitespace, white cards floating on pink-tinted backgrounds, a single humanist sans, and rounded-corner everything. It reads as approachable, friendly, and unmistakably in the consumer-warm landing page lane. PRODUCT.md Principle 5 puts the system on notice: the very things that make this welcoming are the same things every au-pair, doula, and family-services Wix template ships by default. The system is intentionally small and tightly scoped. One typeface (Plus Jakarta Sans) carries every role, weight does the hierarchy work, color commits hard to a single dusty-rose hue, and shadows are a quiet accent rather than a depth language. Treat this DESIGN.md as the Before photograph.
keyCharacteristics: Single typeface (Plus Jakarta Sans) handling every role
Single accent hue: dusty rose, used for CTAs, links, eyebrow labels, section headers
White cards on pink-tinted (surface) backgrounds, alternating section by section
Quiet shadow language: sm at rest, md on hover, lg reserved for hero
Hover affordance on every card: shadow lift plus 4px upward translate

rules.name: The One-Color Rule
rules.body: The system uses exactly one accent. No secondary palette, no tertiary, no status colors. Errors, successes, and warnings, if introduced later, must be designed as additions to this rule, not silent extensions.

rules.name: The Two-Stripe Rule
rules.body: Section backgrounds alternate between card (white) and surface (pink-tinted). Nesting more backgrounds (a third tone, a gradient, a tinted card) is forbidden; the two-stripe rhythm is the page's pulse.

rules.name: The Cool-Text-on-Warm-Bg Tension
rules.body: Body and muted text colors are cool slate; the rest of the palette is warm pink. The mismatch is currently load-bearing (it keeps the warm tones from going Pinterest-mom) but should be a deliberate choice in future work, not an accident.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Stack
rules.body: Every section opens with the same three-element stack: uppercase eyebrow label in primary, then a 700-weight title, then optional body copy. The pattern is the site's main rhythm device. It is also dangerously close to template territory; use sparingly in any redesign.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: All hierarchy is achieved through weight (400 vs 600 vs 700 vs 800) and size, never through family. Adding a second typeface is a deliberate act, not a reflex.

rules.name: The Hover-Earns-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No surface is shadowed at rest beyond the whisper-sm. A heavier shadow without an interaction context (hover, focus, hero) reads as decoration and is forbidden.

rules.name: No Inner Shadows. No Glow. No Backdrop-Blur.
rules.body: The system contains no inset shadows, no colored glows around accent elements, and no glassmorphism. Don't add them.

dos: Do keep typography hierarchy through weight and size, in a single family, until a paired typeface is deliberately chosen.
Do use surface and card as the only two section background tones. Alternate them for rhythm.
Do anchor every section with the eyebrow + title + body stack, or break the pattern visibly. Don't half-break it.
Do keep CTAs to the pill shape across the system; if you change the shape, change every instance.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on the FadeInSection wrapper (currently does not). PRODUCT.md requires it.
Do treat shadow as a hover response, not a resting decoration.
Do carry oklch() notation in code when adding new colors, even if hex remains in the frontmatter for Stitch compliance.
donts: Don't ship a Cultural Care HQ corporate look. Stock photography, generic gradients, trusted-by-families trust-bar treatments.
Don't drift into Pinterest-mom / Etsy-shop kitsch. Script fonts, watercolor flourishes, oversaturated pinks, Hey Mama copy.
Don't ship the SaaS-landing reflex. Hero metric stat blocks, gradient buttons, identical icon-and-heading card grids, Why families love us feature lists.
Don't make Kim's photo the hero of every section. Over-the-top portrait worship.
Don't add a second accent hue without a stated reason. The One-Color Rule is structural, not stylistic.
Don't add border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards or callouts.
Don't add glassmorphism, backdrop-blur, or hero-metric blocks.
Don't repeat the icon-and-heading card grid pattern more than once per page.
Don't animate max-height or height for menu transitions. Use grid-template-rows: 0fr to 1fr instead.
Don't keep #fff literal anywhere; tint white toward the brand hue.
Don't keep Plus Jakarta Sans by default in any future work. It is on the reflex-reject list.
